text:
He will most likely be found **not guilty of arson**. Arson requires malice (intent or reckless disregard of a known risk of fire), and the fire here resulted only from his negligently forgetting to turn off the stove. Voluntary intoxication is not what negates the mental state; rather, even sober, his conduct was mere negligence, which does not satisfy arson's mens rea.

CONFIDENCE: 82
